text: Tilewise — Learned Cost Models for Cross-Architecture Tensor Program Autotuning: Can a cost model pretrained on 2 million measured TVM/Ansor schedules from A100, MI250X and Graviton3 transfer to an unseen accelerator such as the H100 with fewer than 500 on-device measurements, matching full Ansor search throughput on ResNet-50, BERT-Large and a 7B decoder while cutting tuning wall-clock time by 10x?

Fusion Frontier — Searching Operator Fusion Spaces Beyond Greedy Heuristics in Graph Compilers: How much end-to-end speedup over XLA and TorchInductor default fusion is left on the table across 120 HuggingFace and TIMM models on 8 H100s when fusion groups are chosen by an integer linear program or Monte Carlo tree search over memory traffic, and does the gain hold under dynamic shapes and mixed precision?

KernelSmith — Search-Based Generation of High-Performance Triton Kernels from Reference PyTorch: Using an LLM-guided evolutionary search over Triton code with on-GPU timing as the only signal, what fraction of the 250 KernelBench tasks reach at least 1.0x of cuBLAS, cuDNN or hand-written baselines on H100 and MI300X, how many compile-and-run trials does it take, and do the discovered kernels port across GPU generations without retuning at 1e-3 relative error?

Compiler Support for Structured and Unstructured Sparsity on Tensor Cores: Can a sparse tensor compiler extending TACO and SparseTIR with format-aware tiling deliver over 2x speedup versus cuSPARSE on SuiteSparse matrices and 50-90% magnitude-pruned BERT and ViT weights on A100 and H100 GPUs, and at what sparsity level does it cross over against dense cuBLAS for both SpMM and SDDMM?

Polyhedral Scheduling Meets Learned Search for Deep Learning Operators: Do polyhedral loop transformations from Pluto and MLIR's Affine dialect, used as a structured action space for a learned search procedure, find faster schedules than Ansor and Halide's autoscheduler on 40 convolution, attention and stencil operators across Xeon, Graviton and A100 hardware, and within what tuning budget measured in device-hours?

Portable Peak — Performance Portability of a Single Kernel Source Across NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs: Writing FlashAttention-style, GEMM and layernorm kernels once in a tile-level DSL such as Triton, Mojo or TileLang, how close do they get to vendor-tuned peak on H100, MI300X and Ponte Vecchio, which hardware characteristics (shared memory size, matrix-unit shape, warp width) account for the residual gap, and can autotuning close it?

Shape Shifter — Dynamic-Shape Compilation Without Recompilation Storms: For workloads with highly variable sequence lengths and batch sizes, can symbolic-shape compilation with bucketed kernel specialisation in TorchInductor and TVM Relax match static-shape throughput within 5% while keeping the compilation cache under 200 kernels, measured on speech recognition, graph neural network and recommendation traces?
Autotuning Budgets: How many on-device measurements does Ansor actually need before GEMM schedules stop improving on H100s?

Microbench Atlas — Tensor Core Latencies: Can a suite of 300 PTX microbenchmarks recover per-instruction latency, throughput and memory-hierarchy parameters for Hopper and Blackwell GPUs accurately enough to predict kernel runtime within 10% for a compiler cost model?

Bubble Burst — Zero-Bubble Pipeline Schedules for Heterogeneous Layer Stacks: When pipeline stages have unequal compute from mixed attention, mixture-of-experts and convolution layers, can an ILP-derived schedule that splits backward passes into input- and weight-gradient parts remove more than 90% of pipeline bubbles on 64 H100s, and how does its throughput compare with 1F1B, interleaved 1F1B and ZB-H2 on 2B- to 30B-parameter networks?

Near-Zero-Stall Checkpointing for Large Training Jobs: Can asynchronous, incremental and erasure-coded checkpointing to the host memory of peer nodes cut per-checkpoint training stall below 1 second for a 30B-parameter model on 256 GPUs, allowing a checkpoint every iteration, and how does recovered goodput after injected node failures compare with CheckFreq, Gemini and torch.distributed.checkpoint?

Collective Synthesis — Topology-Aware Synthesis of All-Reduce and All-to-All Algorithms: Can a solver-based synthesiser in the spirit of TACCL and TE-CCL generate collective algorithms for multi-rail NVLink and InfiniBand clusters that beat NCCL by more than 20% on all-to-all for expert-parallel mixture-of-experts training at 128 and 512 GPUs, and how long does synthesis take as topologies grow?

Straggler Tolerance — Absorbing Slow Workers in Synchronous Data Parallelism: Across a month of job traces from a 1,000-GPU cluster, what fraction of iteration time is lost to stragglers from thermal throttling, flaky links and noisy neighbours, and can adaptive micro-batch rebalancing or partial-reduce schemes recover at least half of that loss without changing final convergence on ImageNet and Criteo, versus dropping the slowest 2% of workers?

Auto-Parallel Planner — Automatic Search over Data, Tensor, Pipeline and Expert Parallel Layouts: Can a cost-model-driven planner like Alpa or nnScaler, extended with communication-overlap and memory rematerialisation decisions, match or beat expert hand-tuned Megatron configurations for 10 model families on clusters of 16 to 512 GPUs, and how often does its predicted throughput rank configurations correctly?

Resizing Training Jobs on Preemptible GPUs Without Restart: When spot instances disappear and reappear mid-run, can on-the-fly resharding of optimizer state and model parameters across a changing number of GPUs (32 to 128) keep goodput above 85% of a dedicated cluster at under half the cost, compared with Bamboo, Oobleck and checkpoint-restart baselines on 7-day traces of AWS and GCP spot availability?

Low-Bit Wire — Gradient and Parameter Compression for Cross-Datacenter Training: With training spread across two datacenters linked by a 100 Gbps WAN, how far can 4-bit quantised all-reduce, top-k sparsification and DiLoCo-style infrequent synchronisation cut communication volume while keeping ResNet-152 and ViT-L accuracy within 0.5% of single-site training, and which combination wins at what bandwidth?
Silent Data Corruption: How often do bad GPUs silently corrupt gradients in 4,000-GPU training runs, and how cheaply can it be found?

NCCL Tuning Map: How do NCCL ring, tree and NVLS algorithms compare for all-reduce, all-gather and reduce-scatter from 1 KB to 4 GB on DGX H100 and GB200 NVL72 systems, and where do default tuning thresholds mispick?

Card Sharp — Learned Cardinality Estimation That Holds Up Under Data Drift: How quickly do learned cardinality estimators such as MSCN, NeuroCard and DeepDB degrade on the JOB, STATS-CEB and DSB benchmarks as tables receive 10-50% updates, and can incremental retraining with under one minute of CPU time per update batch keep q-error and end-to-end PostgreSQL query latency below that of the native histogram estimator?

Plan Steer — Learned Hint Selection for Production Query Optimisers: Can a Bao-style bandit choosing among PostgreSQL and Spark SQL optimiser hint sets, trained on 50,000 queries from TPC-DS, JOB and a real BI workload, cut 95th-percentile latency by more than 30% without ever slowing any query by over 2x, and how many executed queries does it need before it beats the default optimiser?

Learned Indexes Under Heavy Writes and Disk-Resident Data: Do learned index structures such as ALEX, LIPP and PGM-index still outperform B+-trees and ART once workloads include 50% inserts, string keys and data larger than memory on NVMe SSD, measured by throughput and tail latency on the SOSD datasets and YCSB at 200 million keys?

Join Order Search — Reinforcement Learning for Join Enumeration in 100-Table Queries: For very large join queries beyond the reach of dynamic programming, does a graph-neural-network join enumerator trained with reinforcement learning on synthetic schemas produce plans whose execution cost is within 10% of the best known plan on JOB, its extensions and 100-relation queries, faster than GEQO and Neo?

Zero-Shot Costing — Cross-Database Transferable Cost Models: Can a cost model trained on query plans from 20 diverse databases predict runtime on a completely unseen database and schema with median q-error under 1.5, outperforming PostgreSQL's analytic cost model and per-database learned models, and how much do a few hundred queries of fine-tuning on the target help, measured on IMDB, STATS and TPC-DS at scale factor 100?

Tuning Pilot — Sample-Efficient Database Knob Tuning with Transfer Across Workloads: Can Bayesian optimisation with workload embeddings transferred from 30 previous tuning sessions find PostgreSQL and MySQL configurations within 5% of the best known throughput on TPC-C, YCSB and TPC-H in under 20 trial runs, compared with OtterTune, CDBTune, random search and defaults, and do the gains hold as data grows tenfold?

Query Optimisation for Hybrid Vector and Relational Queries: For queries that combine filters on structured columns with approximate nearest-neighbour search over embeddings, can a cost-based optimiser choosing between pre-filtering, post-filtering and filtered HNSW traversal reach 95% recall at 3x lower latency than pgvector and Milvus defaults across selectivities from 0.1% to 90% on 100 million vectors?
Cardinality Errors That Matter: Which cardinality misestimates in JOB queries actually change the chosen PostgreSQL plan, and by how much do they inflate runtime?

Learned Sorting — Model-Based Sorting for Columnar Engines: Can CDF-model-based sorting and radix partitioning beat optimised IPS4o and std::sort by 2x on 1 billion keys of real distributions, and does the gain carry into hash join build phases in DuckDB?

Paged Tiering — KV-Cache Offloading Across HBM, Host DRAM and NVMe for Long-Context LLM Serving: For multi-turn chat traces with 32K to 1M token contexts, can a tiered KV-cache manager that prefetches blocks from host memory and NVMe over PCIe 5 keep time-to-first-token within 20% of all-in-HBM serving while raising cache hit rates and throughput per H100 by 3x over vLLM prefix caching, and which eviction heuristic matters most on ShareGPT traces?

Draft Tree — Adaptive Speculative Decoding Under Real Batch Loads: How do the speedups of tree-based speculative decoding methods such as EAGLE-2, Medusa and lookahead decoding shrink as batch size grows from 1 to 256 on H100s, and can a scheduler that sets draft length per request from the observed acceptance rate keep a net throughput gain over plain decoding at every load level?

Step Batcher — Iteration-Level Batching for Diffusion Model Serving: Can continuous batching that mixes requests at different denoising steps and resolutions raise images per second for Stable Diffusion XL and Flux on 8 A100s by 2x over static batching at the same 99th-percentile latency target, and how should requests be packed when step counts range from 4 to 50 and resolutions from 512 to 2048 pixels?

Serving Terabyte-Scale Recommendation Embedding Tables: For DLRM-style recommenders with 2 TB embedding tables, can a hot-row cache in GPU memory combined with CXL-attached memory and SmartNIC lookups sustain 1 million queries per second at under 10 ms p99, and how does cost per query compare with sharded-GPU and CPU-only deployments on production-like Criteo traces?

Cold Starts — Sub-Second Model Loading for Serverless GPU Inference: Can streaming weights directly from NVMe and peer GPU memory with layer-wise pipelined execution bring cold-start latency for 1B- to 30B-parameter vision and speech models under 1 second, beating container-restart baselines by 10x on Azure Functions traces, and at what extra host memory and PCIe bandwidth cost when 50 models share each node?

Multiplexed GPUs — Spatial Sharing of Accelerators Across Many Small Models: When hundreds of small vision, speech and ranking models share an 8-GPU server, can a scheduler combining MIG partitions, MPS and temporal slicing meet per-model latency targets for 99% of requests while doubling utilisation versus one-model-per-GPU deployment on Alibaba and Azure serving traces?
Batching Knees: At what batch size does ResNet-50 serving on one L4 GPU stop gaining throughput?
Quantised Vision Serving — INT4 in Practice: Does weight-only INT4 quantisation raise served throughput for vision transformers on A10G and L4 GPUs once dequantisation cost is counted?

Bucketed Audio Batching: Does simply grouping Whisper requests by audio length before batching cut 99th-percentile latency on T4 and L4 GPUs by more than 30% versus first-come batching at equal throughput and equal GPU count?

Loader Bound — Eliminating Input-Pipeline Stalls in Vision Training: Across 30 public training recipes on 8 H100s, what fraction of GPU time is idle waiting on JPEG decoding, augmentation and remote object storage, and can offloading decode to NVIDIA DALI or on-GPU nvJPEG plus a shared cache like Cachew or tf.data service cut epoch time by 2x at equal accuracy for ResNet-50, ViT-B and video models on Kinetics-400?

Shuffle Quality Versus Throughput in Streaming Datasets: When datasets are streamed from S3 as WebDataset or MosaicML MDS shards, how does limited-buffer shuffling affect final ImageNet and audio-classification accuracy compared with full random access, and what shard size and buffer size give within 0.2% of full-shuffle accuracy at the highest read throughput?

Fabric Tuning — Congestion Management on RoCE Training Fabrics: In a 1,024-GPU RoCEv2 cluster running mixed all-reduce and all-to-all traffic, how do DCQCN, HPCC and Swift compare on job completion time and tail flow completion time, and can adaptive multipath routing with packet spraying close the gap to InfiniBand within 5% at 400 Gbps per port?

Direct to GPU — Feeding GPUs Straight from NVMe for Graph and Recommendation Training: Can GPUDirect Storage and BaM-style GPU-initiated I/O sample billion-edge graphs and terabyte embedding tables directly from NVMe arrays fast enough to keep 8 A100s above 80% utilisation, versus CPU-mediated loading in DGL and PyG on ogbn-papers100M and MAG240M?

Parallel Filesystem Performance for ML Checkpoint Bursts: When 2,048 GPUs write a 5 TB checkpoint at once, how do Lustre, WekaFS, DAOS and object storage with local NVMe staging compare on write bandwidth and time to resume, and what striping and aggregation settings bring checkpoint time under 30 seconds, and how much does each option change the restart cost after a full-cluster failure on a 2,048-GPU training job running for 30 days?

Dedup Store — Content-Defined Deduplication for Model Repositories: Across 50,000 fine-tuned checkpoints on the Hugging Face Hub, how much storage can chunk-level and tensor-level deduplication with delta compression save, at what upload and download throughput, and does a Zstandard-plus-XOR-delta scheme outperform the Xet and Git LFS backends on reconstruction latency?

Reconfigurable Optical Topologies for Training Clusters: Can an optical switch that rewires a 512-accelerator cluster between ring, torus and fat-tree layouts per training phase, as in TPUv4, deliver at least 25% higher all-to-all bandwidth for mixture-of-experts jobs than a static fat-tree, and how often must it reconfigure given 10 ms switching latency?
Training Data Formats: Is Parquet, Arrow IPC or a raw mmap array fastest for random training reads?
Packet Spraying for All-Reduce: Does per-packet spraying over 8 equal-cost paths cut ring all-reduce completion time on 400 Gbps Ethernet versus ECMP hashing, and by how much when links fail?

Typewise — Neural Type Inference for Gradual Migration of Large Python Codebases: Can a type predictor combining static constraint solving with a code model, run over the 50 largest untyped PyPI packages, produce annotations that pass mypy --strict on over 80% of functions, beat Type4Py and HiTyper on ManyTypes4Py top-1 accuracy, and how many developer edits do the remaining errors require?

Super Search — Learned Proposal Distributions for x86 and AArch64 Superoptimisation: Can a stochastic superoptimiser in the style of STOKE, guided by a proposal model trained on 1 million LLVM basic blocks, find rewrites that are SMT-proven equivalent and at least 10% faster on the BHive benchmark more often than STOKE and Souper within one CPU-hour per block, and do the gains survive inside full SPEC CPU 2017 binaries?

Legacy Lift — Decompilation to Readable C for Porting Legacy Binaries: How often can a neural decompiler fine-tuned on 2 million compiled functions recover C source from stripped -O2 x86 binaries that recompiles and passes the original test suites, compared with Ghidra and Hex-Rays, and how much does the recovered code reduce porting effort for 20 legacy embedded programs moved to ARM?

Automated Translation of COBOL Programs to Java With Test Equivalence: For 300 open-source and banking-style COBOL programs, can a pipeline of syntactic transpilation plus search-based repair produce Java that matches outputs on 10,000 generated inputs per program, compared with commercial rule-based translators, and how readable is the result by cyclomatic complexity and maintainer ratings?

Borrow Fixer — Program Repair for Compilation Errors in Rust: Can a repair engine combining borrow-checker error messages with enumerative search over ownership edits fix 70% of real-world compilation failures mined from 5,000 GitHub Rust projects, outperforming rustc's suggestions and Clippy, and does the repaired code keep the original performance on Criterion benchmarks and pass existing cargo test suites?

Sheet Synth — Scaling Programming-by-Example to Real Spreadsheet Workloads: Can a bottom-up enumerative synthesiser with learned pruning over a DSL of 200 string and table operators solve over 90% of 5,000 real spreadsheet transformation tasks from FlashFill and SyGuS benchmarks within 10 seconds each, and how many examples does it need per task compared with FlashFill++ and DreamCoder?
Typed Tax — Gradual Typing Overheads: How much runtime overhead do sound gradual types add in Typed Racket and Reticulated Python across the 20 GTP benchmarks?

Saturated Loops — Equality Saturation for Loop Optimisation: Can egg-based equality saturation with learned rule scheduling find faster loop nests than LLVM -O3 and Polly on the 30 PolyBench kernels within a 60-second compile budget per kernel?

Incremental Parsing — Error-Recovering Parsers: Can a GLR-based incremental parser generator match tree-sitter's reparse latency under 1 ms on 100,000-line files while producing more accurate error recovery on 10,000 real broken edits across Python, Java, TypeScript and Rust?

Sparse Anchors — Query-Efficient Open-Vocabulary Detection on Long-Tail Categories: On LVIS rare classes and the 1,203-category split of Objects365, can a DETR-style detector with 50 learned sparse queries match the AP of a 900-query Grounding DINO baseline when text embeddings are distilled from a frozen SigLIP encoder, how much of the rare-class gap closes with 10 million pseudo-boxes mined from web captions, and does throughput on 8 H100s improve at least 2x?

Token Pruning for High-Resolution Panoptic Segmentation: When Mask2Former-style models run at 2048x1024 on Cityscapes and Mapillary Vistas, can a learned token-dropping schedule that discards 60 percent of background tokens after the third encoder stage preserve PQ within 0.5 points, and how do latency, memory and per-class PQ on thin structures such as poles and traffic signs change on an A100 and a Jetson Orin?

Flow at Scale — Training Optical Flow Estimators on Massive Procedurally Rendered Video: If RAFT and SEA-RAFT are pretrained on 5 million procedurally rendered frame pairs with physically based motion blur and rolling shutter instead of FlyingChairs and FlyingThings, how far do end-point errors on Sintel final, KITTI 2015 and Spring fall before fine-tuning, which rendering parameters drive most of the gain, and does it hold at 4K input?

Metric Depth from One Shot: Can a monocular depth model fine-tuned from Depth Anything V2 on 200 thousand phone-captured frames paired with LiDAR depth maps recover absolute scale within 5 percent AbsRel across NYUv2, KITTI and ETH3D without any camera intrinsics at inference?

Edge Instance — Real-Time Instance Segmentation Under a 5-Watt Power Budget: How close can a quantized YOLO-style instance segmenter get to the COCO mask AP of RTMDet-Ins-L while running at 30 frames per second under 5 watts on a Raspberry Pi 5 with a Hailo-8 accelerator, which architectural choices matter most at this budget, and does knowledge distillation from a large teacher recover more AP than neural architecture search?

Dense Matching — Unified Correspondence for Flow, Stereo and Wide-Baseline Matching: Does a single transformer trained jointly on optical flow, rectified stereo and wide-baseline image matching with a shared cost-volume head beat task-specific RoMa, RAFT-Stereo and SEA-RAFT models on MegaDepth pose AUC, Middlebury bad-2 and Sintel EPE at equal parameter count, and does joint training help most when one task has ten times less labeled data than the others?

Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting for City-Scale Scenes on Consumer GPUs: For aerial and street-level captures covering 2 square kilometers, can a hierarchical level-of-detail Gaussian splatting representation streamed from disk render novel views at 60 frames per second on a single RTX 4090 with under 12 GB of VRAM, and how much PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS does it lose against a monolithic model trained on 8 H100s on the MatrixCity and Mill-19 benchmarks?

Few-View Fields — Sparse-Input Neural Radiance Fields with Monocular Geometry Priors: With only three input views on LLFF, DTU and Mip-NeRF 360, does regularizing a Zip-NeRF backbone with depth and normal maps from off-the-shelf monocular estimators close more than half the PSNR gap to the full-view setting, and how does the benefit change as the angular spread between input views grows from 10 to 90 degrees?

Gaussian SLAM — Dense Mapping and Tracking with Gaussian Splats at Room and Building Scale: Can an RGB-D SLAM system that represents the map as 3D Gaussians maintain sub-centimeter absolute trajectory error on Replica and ScanNet++ while running in real time at 30 Hz on a laptop GPU, how does accuracy degrade on 500-meter building traversals with loop closures, and which map-pruning rule best limits memory growth?

Dynamic Splats — Compact Representations for Long Dynamic Scenes: How many bytes per frame are needed to represent a 10-minute multi-view dynamic capture with deformable 3D Gaussians at 30 dB PSNR on the Neural 3D Video and Technicolor datasets, and does a learned keyframe-plus-residual codec beat per-frame retraining by an order of magnitude in storage?

Relightable Captures: Can inverse rendering on top of Gaussian splats recover albedo, roughness and environment lighting well enough to relight captured objects with under 0.05 LPIPS error against reference relit photographs on the Stanford-ORB benchmark?

Generalizable Reconstruction Without Per-Scene Optimization: Can a large feed-forward model trained on 100 thousand scenes from DL3DV and RealEstate10K predict pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians from 8 unposed images in under a second, how close does it come to per-scene optimized 3DGS in PSNR and LPIPS on held-out scenes, and how does the gap shrink as training scenes grow tenfold?

Mesh from Splats — Watertight Surface Extraction from Gaussian Splatting: Does constraining 2D Gaussian surfels with a learned signed distance field produce meshes with lower Chamfer distance than NeuS2 and 2DGS on DTU and Tanks and Temples while keeping training under 15 minutes per scene on one GPU, and does the resulting mesh keep thin geometry such as chair legs and railings that marching cubes on density fields loses?

Frame Skip — Adaptive Temporal Sampling for Long-Video Question Answering: On EgoSchema, Video-MME and LongVideoBench, can a lightweight scorer that selects 32 of several thousand frames by query-conditioned relevance match the accuracy of uniform sampling at 256 frames for a 7B video-language model, how much wall-clock and GPU memory does it save per hour of video, and does the selector transfer to new benchmarks without retraining?

Tubelet Merge — Token Merging for Efficient Video Transformers: How much can merging redundant spatiotemporal tokens across frames cut the FLOPs of VideoMAE ViT-L on Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2 before top-1 accuracy drops by more than one point at batch size 32 on an A100, and do motion-heavy classes suffer more than appearance-driven ones?

Autoregressive Generation of Minute-Long Videos at Constant Memory: Can a video diffusion transformer distilled into a causal, chunk-by-chunk generator with a rolling key-value cache produce 60-second 720p clips at constant memory on one H100, how does temporal consistency measured by FVD and subject-identity similarity decay compared with bidirectional baselines such as Wan 2.1, and which cache-eviction rule slows that decay most?

Streaming Action — Online Temporal Action Detection with Bounded Latency: On THUMOS14 and the Ego4D moment queries benchmark, can a streaming detector with a fixed 2-second lookahead reach within 3 mAP points of offline ActionFormer, and how does detection delay trade off against accuracy as the memory window shrinks from 5 minutes to 30 seconds?

Compressed Domain — Video Recognition Directly from Codec Motion Vectors and Residuals: Can action recognition and object tracking models that read H.265 motion vectors and residuals without full decoding match RGB-based accuracy on Kinetics-400 and MOT17 while cutting end-to-end compute by 5x on a server ingesting 200 camera streams?

Few-Step Video — Consistency Distillation for Text-to-Video Generation: Can a 14-billion-parameter text-to-video diffusion model be distilled to 4 sampling steps with consistency and distribution-matching losses while keeping VBench total score within 1 point of the 50-step teacher, how much training on 32 H100s does distillation require, and do motion smoothness and dynamic degree degrade more than per-frame aesthetic quality?

Video Tokenizer Bench: How do causal 3D VAEs from recent open video models compare in reconstruction PSNR, temporal flicker and downstream generation FVD at matched compression ratios of 4x8x8 and 8x16x16 on UCF-101 and a 1,000-clip held-out set?

Egocentric Hands — Efficient Hand-Object Interaction Recognition on Wearable Devices: Can a sub-50M-parameter model on smart-glasses hardware recognize EPIC-KITCHENS-100 hand-object interactions within 5 points of large offline models?

Slide-Level Pretraining for Computational Pathology Across 100 Thousand Slides: Does pretraining a slide-level aggregator over frozen UNI and Virchow patch embeddings on 100 thousand H&E whole-slide images with masked tile modeling improve few-shot subtyping on TCGA lung and kidney cohorts and grading on PANDA over attention-based multiple-instance learning, and how many slides per class match full supervision?

Report First — Grounded Chest X-Ray Report Generation with Region-Level Findings: On MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert Plus, can a radiology report generator that first localizes findings with bounding boxes and then writes sentences conditioned on each region beat MAIRA-2 and R2GenGPT on RadGraph F1 and CheXbert clinical accuracy, and do radiologists in a blinded reader study rate its reports as more complete?

Ultrasound Anywhere — Label-Efficient Segmentation for Point-of-Care Ultrasound: With only 50 annotated cine loops per view, can a video segmentation model pretrained with masked autoencoding on 2 million unlabeled frames from handheld scanners segment left-ventricle, fetal head and thyroid nodule boundaries with Dice within 2 points of fully supervised nnU-Net on CAMUS, HC18 and TN3K, and does temporal consistency improve ejection-fraction estimates?

Cross-Scanner MRI — Brain MRI Segmentation That Transfers Across 30 Scanners and Field Strengths: Does training with synthetic contrast and resolution augmentation in the style of SynthSeg let a single 3D U-Net segment 30 brain structures on 1.5T, 3T and portable 0.064T low-field scans with Dice drops under 3 points relative to in-scanner models, using ADNI, OASIS-3 and a portable-MRI cohort?

Masked Volume Modeling on 200 Thousand Abdominal CT Scans: How much does self-supervised pretraining on 200 thousand unlabeled CT volumes improve organ and tumor segmentation on TotalSegmentator, AbdomenAtlas and the MSD liver and pancreas tasks over nnU-Net trained from scratch, and at what labeled-set size does the gain disappear?

Low-Dose Reconstruction — Diffusion Priors for Sparse-View and Low-Dose CT: Can a score-based diffusion prior trained on full-dose CT reconstruct 60-view and quarter-dose scans from the AAPM Mayo challenge with higher PSNR and lesion contrast than FBPConvNet and learned primal-dual methods, and can sampling be cut to 10 network passes per slice?

Gigapixel Speed — Fast Whole-Slide Inference by Learned Tile Skipping: Can a low-magnification scout network that skips 80 percent of tiles keep slide-level metastasis detection AUC on CAMELYON16 within 0.01 while cutting inference time per slide from minutes to seconds?

Echo Video — Automated Cardiac Measurement from Echocardiography Clips: Can a video transformer trained on EchoNet-Dynamic and EchoNet-LVH estimate ejection fraction, left-ventricular wall thickness and chamber volumes within inter-observer variability on clips from three external hospitals with different ultrasound vendors, and does pretraining on 500 thousand unlabeled echo videos halve the labeled data needed?

Crop Calendar — Satellite Time-Series Foundation Models for Smallholder Crop Mapping: Can a temporal transformer pretrained on 5 years of Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 time series over sub-Saharan Africa map maize, sorghum and cassava on fields smaller than half a hectare with F1 above 0.8 given only 500 labeled parcels per country, and how does it compare with Presto, SatMAE and random forest baselines on CropHarvest and EuroCrops?

Near-Real-Time Flood Mapping from SAR Under Cloud Cover: On Sen1Floods11 and the recent Kuro Siwo dataset, can a change-detection network that pairs pre-event and post-event Sentinel-1 SAR with a digital elevation model reach IoU above 0.75 on flooded areas across 40 unseen river basins, and how much does adding commercial X-band SAR from ICEYE improve detection of shallow urban flooding?

Footprint Everywhere — Building Footprint Extraction at Continental Scale: Can a segmentation model trained on 0.5-meter imagery from SpaceNet, the Microsoft building footprints and Open Buildings labels extract polygonal footprints with regularized corners at continental scale on 64 GPUs in under a week, and how do completeness and polygon IoU vary between dense informal settlements and rural villages across 20 countries?

Earth Embeddings — Comparing Geospatial Foundation Models on a Unified Benchmark: How do Prithvi-EO-2.0, SatMAE++, DOFA and CROMA rank on GEO-Bench and PANGAEA across land cover, crop type, flood and building tasks when fine-tuned with identical budgets, and does multispectral and SAR pretraining beat RGB-only pretraining at equal compute?

Super-Resolved Sentinel — Multi-Image Super-Resolution from 10 Meters to 2.5 Meters: Can a multi-temporal super-resolution network that fuses 16 Sentinel-2 revisits produce 2.5-meter imagery that improves downstream building and road segmentation IoU on the WorldStrat dataset by more than 5 points over single-image super-resolution and bicubic upsampling?

Reconstructing Cloud-Covered Optical Imagery with SAR-Guided Diffusion: On SEN12MS-CR-TS, does a conditional diffusion model that combines Sentinel-1 SAR with cloudy Sentinel-2 time series reconstruct surface reflectance with lower error than UnCRtainTS and linear interpolation, and does gap-filled imagery raise crop classification accuracy in monsoon regions?

Canopy Height — Global Forest Height Maps from Spaceborne Lidar and Optical Imagery: Can a model trained on GEDI lidar shots, Sentinel-1 backscatter and Sentinel-2 imagery map forest canopy height at 10-meter resolution with under 4 meters mean absolute error across tropical, temperate and boreal biomes, and does it beat the Lang et al. global canopy height map on tall closed-canopy rainforest?

Change Over Decades — Long-Term Urban Expansion from Landsat Archives: Can a single change-detection model applied to 40 years of Landsat 5, 7, 8 and 9 imagery reconstruct annual built-up extent for 500 cities with accuracy above 90 percent against hand-labeled samples, and does it outperform the Global Human Settlement Layer on cities that grew fastest after 2000?

Fast Sampler — Training-Free Solvers for Diffusion Sampling in Under Ten Steps: Can a higher-order ODE solver whose time steps and coefficients are optimized once per model on 1,000 trajectories beat DPM-Solver++ and UniPC on FID for ImageNet 256 and COCO text-to-image at 5, 8 and 10 function calls, and do the optimized schedules transfer between SDXL, Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX without re-tuning?

Distribution Matching Distillation at 12 Billion Parameters: Can a 12-billion-parameter rectified-flow text-to-image model be distilled into a one-step generator with distribution matching and a GAN loss on 64 H100s while keeping FID on COCO-30K within 2 points of the 28-step teacher and GenEval score within 3 points, and what share of intra-prompt LPIPS diversity survives distillation?

Guidance Interval — Where in the Sampling Trajectory Classifier-Free Guidance Helps: When classifier-free guidance is applied only within a learned interval of noise levels rather than at every step, how do FID, precision and recall on ImageNet 512 with EDM2 and DiT-XL change, and can the best interval be predicted from the noise schedule alone without a per-model sweep?

Pixel Space Again — High-Resolution Diffusion Without a Latent Autoencoder: Can a hierarchical pixel-space diffusion transformer generate 1024x1024 images with FID comparable to latent diffusion at the same training compute of 2,000 H100-hours, and does removing the VAE eliminate fine-texture artifacts in text rendering and faces measured by OCR accuracy and human pairwise judgments?

Cached Denoiser — Reusing Transformer Computation Across Diffusion Timesteps: How much can caching intermediate DiT block outputs across adjacent sampling steps, in the style of DeepCache and FORA, speed up FLUX and Stable Diffusion 3 at 1024 resolution before FID and CLIP score degrade measurably, and does a learned per-block refresh schedule beat fixed caching intervals by 1.5x in speedup?

How Latent Autoencoder Design Limits Image Generation: Across 20 VAEs with 4 to 64 latent channels and 8x to 32x spatial downsampling trained on ImageNet and LAION subsets, how does reconstruction rFID relate to the generation FID a fixed DiT reaches, and is there a channel count beyond which better reconstruction makes generation worse?

Autoregressive vs Diffusion — Matched-Compute Comparison of Image Generators: At equal training compute from 10^20 to 10^22 FLOPs on ImageNet 256, do masked autoregressive models such as MAR and VAR or diffusion transformers such as DiT and SiT reach lower FID and higher recall, which family samples faster at matched quality on one H100, and does the ranking flip at 512 resolution?

Quantized Diffusion — 4-Bit Text-to-Image on Phones: Can low-rank outlier handling keep a fully 4-bit FLUX-schnell within 1 FID point of the 16-bit model while generating a 1024-pixel image in under 2 seconds on a phone NPU?

Layered Composer — Text-to-Image Generation with Editable Transparent Layers: Can a diffusion model trained on 2 million layered design files generate images as separate RGBA layers whose composite matches single-layer FID on COCO, whose layers users can move without retouching, and whose alpha mattes beat post-hoc matting with SAM 2 on boundary quality?
Thin Structures: Can boundary-aware losses raise segmentation IoU on wires, poles and cracks by 10 points?
Glacier Fronts: Can SAR segmentation track calving fronts of 50 glaciers within 100 meters?
Splat Compression: Can vector quantization shrink 3D Gaussian splatting scenes 20x with under 0.3 dB PSNR loss on Mip-NeRF 360?
Pathology at Low Magnification: Can 5x tiles alone match 20x tiles for prostate Gleason grading on PANDA at a fraction of the compute cost?
Sparse Video Attention: How much can block-sparse spatiotemporal attention speed up 720p video diffusion inference before VBench total scores drop?
Planar Indoor Depth: Does enforcing piecewise-planar structure improve monocular depth on ScanNet walls, floors and ceilings without blurring edges in cluttered regions?
Pocket Scans — Neural Surface Reconstruction from Phone Video: Can a hash-grid SDF reconstruct household objects from 30-second phone videos with sub-millimeter Chamfer error on OmniObject3D?

Point Prompt Speed — Fast Promptable Segmentation for Video Annotation: Can a distilled SAM 2 variant with a 10M-parameter encoder track prompted objects at 100 frames per second on DAVIS within 2 J&F points of the full model?

Tonal Bridge — Streaming ASR for Tone Languages Under 50 Hours of Speech: How much word error rate does a chunked Conformer transducer lose against a full-context model on Yoruba, Hausa and Zulu when trained on under 50 hours each, and can explicit pitch-contour inputs plus cross-lingual pretraining on 10,000 hours of unlabeled African speech close the gap at 320 ms latency when trained on a single A100 node?

Cross-Lingual Phone Inventories for Zero-Resource Speech Recognition: When a multilingual wav2vec 2.0 model fine-tuned on 100 languages is asked to transcribe a language it never heard, does mapping its universal phone outputs through a PHOIBLE-derived inventory cut phone error rate relative to grapheme fine-tuning on ten minutes of labeled audio, and which language families benefit most?

Lookahead Budget — Trading Latency for Accuracy in On-Device Streaming Recognition: On a phone-class CPU with 200 MB memory, how does word error rate on LibriSpeech and a noisy far-field meeting corpus change as right-context lookahead varies from 0 to 640 ms in a cache-aware streaming Conformer, and does a learned per-utterance lookahead scheduler beat any fixed setting at matched average latency?

Breath Groups — Learning Phrase-Level Prosody for Long-Form Audiobook Synthesis: Can a TTS model conditioned on a paragraph-level prosody encoder trained on 5,000 hours of LibriTTS-R audiobooks place pauses and emphasis across multi-sentence passages more naturally than sentence-by-sentence VITS, as rated in MUSHRA tests with 40 listeners?

Single Speaker, Many Moods — Few-Shot Expressive TTS for Low-Resource Languages: With only two hours of neutral read speech from one Quechua speaker, can transferring an emotion-and-emphasis latent space learned on 600 hours of expressive English and Spanish yield synthesized speech that native listeners rate as more expressive at no loss in intelligibility, measured by character error rate under a Whisper-large recognizer and a 30-listener comparison test?

Code-Switch Decoder: Does a shared-vocabulary transducer with language-ID-gated output heads lower mixed error rate on Hindi-English and Mandarin-English code-switched speech compared with a single joint vocabulary model of equal size, and does the gain hold in streaming mode at 480 ms?

Iterated Pseudo-Labeling for Low-Resource ASR: Over 12 runs, how many rounds of pseudo-labeling on 20,000 hours of unlabeled Swahili radio broadcasts keep improving a 300M-parameter ASR model, and does filtering pseudo-labels by decoder confidence beat filtering by agreement between acoustic and language model scores?

Stem Ledger — Universal Source Separation Beyond the Four-Stem Paradigm: Can a single band-split transformer trained on MoisesDB plus 2,000 hours of synthetic multitrack mixes separate any named instrument from a full mix given a text query, and how does its signal-to-distortion ratio compare with dedicated four-stem Demucs v4 models on MUSDB18-HQ?

Note Grid — Multi-Instrument Transcription from Polyphonic Recordings at Scale: Does training a sequence-to-sequence MIDI transcriber on 30,000 hours of audio matched to score files via dynamic time warping, rather than the 200 hours of exactly synchronized MAESTRO and Slakh data, improve note-with-offset F1 on held-out orchestral, jazz and guitar recordings, and how much timing noise can the model tolerate before onset precision drops?

Dawn Chorus — Self-Supervised Representations for Passive Acoustic Bird Census: Can an audio encoder pretrained with masked spectrogram modeling on 100,000 hours of unlabeled field recordings from autonomous recorders identify 1,500 bird species in dense dawn-chorus soundscapes better than BirdNET and Perch, measured by mean average precision on the BirdCLEF 2025 soundscape set, and how many labeled clips per rare species are needed to reach parity?

Few-Shot Call-Type Discovery in Marine Mammal Recordings: Given 40,000 hours of hydrophone audio from the North Pacific with only a few hundred annotated humpback and orca calls, does clustering contrastive embeddings recover call types that marine biologists recognize, and how does detection recall at a fixed false-alarm rate per hour compare with spectrogram-correlation templates and a supervised CNN?

Beat Thread — Real-Time Beat and Downbeat Tracking for Live Performance Accompaniment: Can a causal temporal convolutional tracker running under 10 ms per frame on a Raspberry Pi 5 follow tempo changes in live rubato piano and Afro-Cuban percussion as accurately as offline models on the Ballroom, GTZAN and Hainsworth sets, and does adding a lightweight particle filter over meter hypotheses reduce downbeat F-measure loss at tempo transitions?

Chord Atlas: Does pretraining a chord recognizer on 1 million user-contributed lead sheets synchronized to audio improve accuracy on rare extended chords in jazz and bossa nova relative to training on 1,200 expert-annotated songs?
Lyric Lock: How accurately can a Whisper-based timestamper mark sung lyrics word by word in polyphonic pop, and does vocal separation help?

Pivot-Free — Direct Translation Between Low-Resource African Language Pairs: For pairs such as Igbo-Swahili and Amharic-Tigrinya, where fewer than 100,000 parallel sentences exist, does a 1.3B-parameter many-to-many model trained with mined parallel data and back-translation outperform English-pivot cascades on FLORES-200 chrF++, and how much of the gain comes from mining quality versus model capacity on a budget of 64 A100-days?

Dialect Spread — Machine Translation Across Arabic Dialect Continua: Can a translation model trained on Modern Standard Arabic plus a small amount of Egyptian and Levantine data generalize to Gulf, Maghrebi and Sudanese dialect input, measured by BLEU and human adequacy scores on the MADAR corpus, and does dialect-tagged continued pretraining on 5 billion tokens of social media text help more than synthetic dialect paraphrasing?

Terminology-Constrained Translation for Medical Content in Low-Resource Languages: Does injecting bilingual medical glossaries as soft decoding constraints in NLLB-200 raise term accuracy on WHO patient leaflets translated into Tigrinya, Lao and Haitian Creole above 90 percent without lowering COMET scores relative to plain beam search?

Script Bridge — Transliteration-Aware Tokenization for Multilingual Models: When the same language appears in multiple scripts, as with Serbian, Punjabi and Kazakh, does a tokenizer that maps scripts to a shared romanized vocabulary before byte-pair encoding improve downstream translation chrF and named entity F1 over SentencePiece trained on raw text, and at what cost in sequence length and training throughput on 16 H100s?

Speech-to-Speech for Unwritten Languages — Direct Translation Without Text Intermediates: For languages without a standard orthography, can a discrete-unit speech-to-speech translation model trained on 300 hours of church recordings with simultaneous spoken translation produce translations that bilingual listeners rate as adequate, and how does ASR-BLEU compare with a cascade that uses a phonetic transcription produced by a universal phone recognizer?

Bitext Sieve: Which combination of LASER3, LaBSE and cross-encoder scoring best filters noisy web-mined parallel text for 30 low-resource languages, measured by downstream chrF++ on FLORES-200 per million retained sentence pairs and per GPU-hour of filtering?

Parallel Bible, Parallel World — Measuring Domain Shift from Religious Text Pretraining in Translation: For 200 languages whose main parallel source is the Bible, how much does a translation model trained on that corpus lose on news and health text compared with in-domain test sets, and can 500 sentences of target-domain data per language recover most of the gap?
Tiny Lexicon: Can a 2,000-word bilingual dictionary alone bootstrap a usable Kinyarwanda-French translator?

Compressing Multi-Vector Retrieval Indexes to Single-Vector Size: Can residual quantization plus learned token pruning shrink a ColBERTv2 index over the 8.8 million passage MS MARCO collection to the storage footprint of a single-vector DPR index while keeping MRR@10 within one point and BEIR nDCG@10 within two points, and how does query latency on a 32-core CPU compare with PLAID and a dense HNSW baseline?

Rewrite Loop — Learned Query Reformulation for Conversational Search: Does a T5-base rewriter trained on query logs to produce self-contained queries from multi-turn conversations improve recall@100 over raw concatenation and over prompting a 70B LLM on TREC CAsT and TopiOCQA, at what fraction of the inference cost, and do the gains hold when the downstream retriever is BM25 rather than a dense bi-encoder?

Hard Negatives at Scale — Mining Strategies for Dense Retriever Training: Across one billion web query-document pairs, how does the choice of negative mining strategy, from in-batch random through BM25-mined to cross-encoder-filtered, affect nDCG@10 on BEIR and MIRACL, how much of the benefit remains once false negatives are removed with a teacher threshold, and how does the optimal batch size shift on 64 H100s?

Sparse Meets Dense — Hybrid Learned Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Multilingual Search: For 18 languages in MIRACL, does fusing SPLADE-style learned sparse vectors with a multilingual dense encoder outperform either alone on nDCG@10, how much does the gain depend on whether the language has a whitespace tokenizer, and can a single shared inverted index serve both with query latency under 50 ms on commodity hardware?

Disk-Resident Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search on SSDs: Can a DiskANN-style graph index over 5 billion 768-dimensional embeddings achieve 95 percent recall@10 at under 5 ms latency using 64 GB of RAM and NVMe storage, and how do product quantization codebook size, graph degree and SSD read patterns trade off against throughput compared with in-memory HNSW and IVF-PQ on the BigANN benchmark?

Fresh Index — Incremental Updates for Dense Retrieval Without Full Re-encoding: When a document collection changes by 5 percent per day, how quickly does retrieval quality of a frozen dense index decay on a news corpus, and does periodically fine-tuning the query encoder alone, while keeping document embeddings fixed, recover nDCG@10 at a fraction of the cost of re-encoding 100 million passages on 8 A100s?

Long Query Distill — Shrinking Cross-Encoder Rerankers for Production Search: Can a 24-layer cross-encoder reranker distilled into a 6-layer student with listwise margin loss keep 95 percent of its nDCG@10 on TREC Deep Learning 2023 and BEIR while cutting reranking latency for the top 100 candidates by ten times on a single L4 GPU, and does distilling from an ensemble of teachers help?
Typo Tolerance: How far does recall@10 of dense e-commerce retrievers drop on misspelled queries taken from real search logs?

Cold Catalog — Content-Based Embeddings for New-Item Cold Start in Large-Scale Recommendation: For items with zero interactions in a catalog of 50 million products, does mapping multimodal content embeddings from images and descriptions into the collaborative embedding space of a two-tower retriever recover recall@100 within ten percent of warm items, and how many interactions per item are needed before the learned collaborative embedding overtakes the content-mapped one?

Long-Context Sequential Recommendation with Efficient Attention: Do linear-attention and state-space sequence models over user histories of 10,000 interactions beat SASRec and BERT4Rec trained on the last 200 items on next-item hit rate@10 across Amazon Reviews 2023, MovieLens-32M and a streaming music dataset, and how do training throughput and serving latency scale with history length on 8 H100s?

Tower Gap — Closing the Quality Gap Between Two-Tower Retrieval and Cross-Interaction Ranking: In a three-stage recommender with candidate retrieval, ranking and reranking, how much of the final ranking model's NDCG is lost because the two-tower retriever never surfaces the right items, and can distilling the ranker's scores into the towers with a listwise loss raise end-to-end recall@500 on a billion-interaction dataset without raising retrieval latency?

Generative IDs — Semantic Item Identifiers for Generative Retrieval in Recommendation: Does representing each item as a sequence of residual-quantized semantic codes, so a decoder can generate item IDs directly, outperform approximate nearest neighbor two-tower retrieval on recall@50 and cold-item coverage across catalogs of 1 million to 100 million items, and how does decoding cost scale with catalog size on a single A100?

Compressing Recommendation Embedding Tables by 100 Times: Can hashing tricks, mixed-dimension embeddings and post-training 4-bit quantization shrink a 2 TB embedding table in a click-through rate model to 20 GB while keeping AUC within 0.1 percent on Criteo 1TB, and which of the three techniques degrades tail items fastest?
Negative Feedback Loop: Does sampling negatives by item popularity in two-tower training increase the catalog coverage of top-100 recommendations compared with uniform sampling, at equal recall@100?

Return Rate as Target: Does training a sequential recommender on next-week return visits instead of next-item clicks raise thirty-day retention in an offline replay on a 50-million-user news dataset with 2 billion sessions?

Gridless Tables — End-to-End Table Structure Recognition for Borderless Financial Statements: Can an image-to-sequence model that outputs HTML table markup directly recover row and column spans in borderless tables from scanned annual reports more accurately than detection-plus-graph pipelines, measured by TEDS on PubTabNet, FinTabNet and a new set of 3,000 multilingual statements, and how does accuracy fall with page skew and scan resolution below 150 DPI?

Ink and Ledger — Handwritten Text Recognition for 18th-Century Parish Registers: Does a TrOCR-style model pretrained on 10 million synthetic handwriting lines in historical scripts, then fine-tuned on 5,000 transcribed lines from Portuguese and Dutch colonial archives, cut character error rate below 8 percent on unseen hands, and how does that compare with Transkribus models trained on each archive separately?

Archive Layout — Reading-Order Recovery for Multi-Column Historical Newspapers: For 19th-century newspapers with irregular column layouts, adverts and mastheads, can a graph neural network over detected text regions recover the human reading order more accurately than heuristic XY-cut and LayoutLMv3 baselines, measured by article segmentation F1 on 20,000 pages from Chronicling America and Europeana, and does adding OCR text to the region nodes help?

OCR-Free Document Question Answering on Visually Dense Pages: Does a pixel-based encoder-decoder that never runs an OCR step match OCR-pipeline models on DocVQA, InfographicVQA and ChartQA when trained on 50 million rendered web pages, how does the gap change on pages with tiny fonts or dense tables, and what input resolution is needed to reach parity on 16 H100s?

Forms in the Wild — Key-Value Extraction from Photographed Forms Across 20 Languages: How well do layout-aware document models trained mostly on English invoices extract key-value pairs from phone photos of government forms in Bengali, Amharic and Thai, measured by field-level F1, and does synthetic data generated by rendering templates with realistic camera distortions recover most of the accuracy lost to scripts and photo conditions?
Math on Paper: Can one encoder-decoder transcribe handwritten mathematical expressions to LaTeX with expression accuracy above 65 percent on CROHME 2023 while running in real time on a tablet?

Damaged Glyphs — Restoring and Reading Degraded Characters in Premodern Chinese Woodblock Prints: Can a diffusion model trained to inpaint worn and broken glyphs on 200,000 woodblock-print character images raise downstream OCR character accuracy on damaged Ming and Qing dynasty pages by at least five points, and how does joint restoration plus recognition compare with a recognizer trained directly on degraded images?

Page Stream — Throughput-Optimized OCR for Billion-Page Digitization Projects: What combination of model distillation, batched GPU inference and adaptive resolution lets a national library run layout analysis plus OCR on one billion pages within a fixed budget of 10,000 GPU-hours, and how much character accuracy is traded for each doubling of throughput?

Cuneiform Reader: Can a detector-plus-classifier trained on rendered 3D scans of clay tablets transliterate Neo-Assyrian cuneiform signs from ordinary museum photographs with sign-level F1 comparable to that of expert Assyriologists?

Speculative Decoding for Large Speech Recognition Models: Can a 40M-parameter CTC draft model proposing tokens for a Whisper-large-v3 target model cut transcription latency by three times on long-form podcast audio without any change in word error rate, and how does acceptance rate vary across languages and noise conditions?
Context Packing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Serving: How much prefill compute does reusing KV caches of popular retrieved passages save for a 70B model at 1,000 queries per second?
Snippet Budget: Does a learned passage compressor that cuts retrieved context by 80 percent keep exact-match on Natural Questions within two points?
Sound Map: Can a 5M-parameter on-device model classify urban sound events across 50 cities?

Music Recs Without Labels — Audio-Content Cold Start for Newly Released Tracks: Can a contrastive audio encoder trained to match listening co-occurrence embeddings place newly uploaded songs in a streaming catalog of 80 million tracks well enough that their first-week stream counts match those of tracks with full collaborative signals?

Kinship Retrieval — Cross-Lingual Search Over Low-Resource Language Archives: Can a multilingual dense retriever fine-tuned on 20,000 machine-translated query-passage pairs let users querying in English find relevant passages in transcribed Yoruba and Twi oral-history archives, measured by recall@20 against bilingual annotators, and does it beat BM25 over translated documents?
Prosody Knobs: Can a TTS model expose disentangled sliders for speaking rate, pitch range and emphasis that listeners perceive as independent in a 30-person study?

Tactile Pretraining for In-Hand Reorientation With a 16-DoF Multifingered Gripper: Does self-supervised pretraining on 2,000 hours of vision-based tactile video, then PPO fine-tuning in Isaac Gym on four A100s, let a 16-DoF hand reorient 40 unseen household objects to arbitrary target poses with fewer drops than vision-only and proprioception-only baselines, and which sensing modality matters most for thin or glossy items?

Demo Tax — How Teleoperation Quality Shapes Imitation Learning Across Twelve Tabletop Tasks: For demonstrations gathered by 20 operators on VR and leader-follower interfaces, how much do hesitant or suboptimal trajectories reduce the success of ACT and Diffusion Policy learners, can automatic demo scoring and filtering recover the loss, and is it cheaper per success to collect fewer expert demos or many more novice ones?

Grasp Bridge — Cross-Embodiment 6-DoF Grasping Across Parallel-Jaw and Multifingered Hands: Can a single grasp network trained on Open X-Embodiment plus a million simulated grasps transfer zero-shot across two-finger, three-finger and five-finger grippers on cluttered bins of 100 objects, and how does its grasp-success rate compare with per-gripper networks trained on each embodiment alone?

Soft Shape — Manipulating Elastoplastic Dough With Differentiable Simulation and Real Fine-Tuning: Can a differentiable material-point simulator, identified from ten minutes of interaction video, learn rolling and pinching skills that form real clay into 25 target 3D shapes within 2 mm Chamfer distance, and how much of the transfer gap closes after 30 real fine-tuning episodes on the physical setup?

Composing Learned Primitives for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation in Homes: When a mobile manipulator chains 8 to 15 learned skills such as open, pick, place and wipe across 50 real kitchens, does a learned handoff value function that predicts chaining success beat hand-written sequencing and end-to-end behavior cloning on full-task completion rate, and where do the chains most often break?

Cable Weave — Dexterous Bimanual Routing of Deformable Linear Objects on Industrial Fixtures: Can a hierarchy of a cable-state tracker, a keypoint high-level planner and a low-level diffusion policy route wires through 6 to 10 clips with over 90 percent success after 200 demonstrations, and how does its throughput compare with skilled human assemblers timed on the identical boards?
Point to Grip — Language-Conditioned Grasping in Clutter: Do 6-DoF grasp predictors trained on ten million rendered scenes beat task-specific networks on cluttered bins of 100 household objects?
Pour Steady: Can a force-aware policy from 150 teleoperated demos pour to a target mass across 20 unseen container shapes?

Gait Recipe — Comparing Sim-to-Real Pipelines for Quadruped Locomotion on Rough Terrain: Holding a Unitree Go2 and a two-billion-step simulation budget on eight H100s fixed, which mix of domain randomization, teacher-student distillation and asymmetric actor-critic yields the best success over 40 outdoor trails of stairs, gravel, mud and snow, and which single ingredient explains the most variance across seeds?

Leap Pup — Agile Vision-Based Jumping and Climbing for Low-Cost Quadrupeds in the Wild: Can a depth-camera locomotion policy trained with massively parallel RL in Isaac Lab let a sub-$3,000 quadruped climb boxes 1.5 times its leg length, clear 60 cm gaps and duck under bars, and how strongly does real-world success depend on the depth-noise model used during training?

Learning Neural Actuator Models to Close the Transfer Gap for Legged Robots: How much real motor data, from one to 60 minutes per joint, does a neural actuator network need to bring simulated torque-tracking error within 5 percent of hardware on three quadrupeds and a biped, and does locomotion trained on these models move faster and more efficiently than one trained on analytic motor curves?

Slip Step — Test-Time Adaptation of Legged Locomotion to Icy and Deformable Ground: Can an online estimator that infers friction and compliance from half a second of proprioceptive history let an ANYmal-class robot cross ice, wet tiles, sand and foam without falling, and how much faster does it adapt than latent RMA-style adaptation trained on an equal simulation budget on the same terrains?

Mocap Prior — Pretraining Humanoid Gait Generators on Retargeted Human Motion Capture: Does pretraining a humanoid policy on 40 hours of retargeted motion capture before RL in simulation speed convergence, raise sample efficiency and yield more natural, lower-energy walking on two real humanoids than training from scratch, and how much motion capture is needed before the benefit saturates?

Thrifty Gait — Learning Metabolically Efficient Quadruped Gaits That Transfer to Hardware: When cost-of-transport terms enter RL training of quadruped gaits, do trot, pace and gallop transitions emerge at speeds matching biological animals, and do real Unitree robots running the learned gaits extend battery runtime by over 20 percent against velocity-tracking-only baselines on a fixed course?

World Models for Blind and Perceptive Foothold Planning on Legged Robots: Can a latent world model trained on 500 hours of logged proprioception and elevation maps plan footholds over stepping stones and rubble with fewer simulation steps than model-free PPO, and does planning in the learned model hold up when real elevation maps carry occlusions and drift from the onboard mapper?

Morph Walk — Transformer Gaits Across Humanoid Morphologies: Can one gait generator trained on 20 simulated humanoid morphologies walk on two unseen real humanoids after 30 minutes of hardware fine-tuning per robot?
Stride Switch: Can one RL-trained quadruped policy switch between walking, crawling and stair climbing within a single stride on hardware without retuning?

Route Learner — Neural Construction Heuristics for Large Vehicle Routing With Time Windows: Can a transformer trained with REINFORCE on ten million synthetic instances solve 10,000-customer capacitated routing with time windows within 1 percent of HGS and LKH-3 at a hundredth the wall-clock time, and does it generalize to the Gehring-Homberger benchmark and real last-mile logs from three cities?

Replenish — Multi-Echelon Inventory Policies With Deep RL Under Lost Sales and Lead Times: For one warehouse feeding 500 stores across 20,000 SKUs with stochastic lead times and perishable goods, does a shared deep RL replenishment policy trained on three years of sales beat base-stock and (s,S) heuristics on combined holding, waste and stockout cost, and what pooling behavior does it learn across stores?

Rail Untangle — Multi-Agent RL for Real-Time Train Rescheduling on Dense Networks: On the Flatland benchmark scaled to 500 trains and a one-week replay of disruptions on a national network, do graph-based multi-train RL dispatchers resolve conflicts with lower total delay than the operator's integer-programming rescheduler, and how does quality degrade as disruption frequency doubles?

Replay Macro: Can offline RL on human strategy-game replays reach Diamond league with no self-play?

Decade Emulator — Generative Emulation of Regional Climate Under Unseen Emission Pathways: Can a diffusion emulator trained on CMIP6 output from 15 Earth system models reproduce regional temperature and precipitation distributions, extremes and teleconnections for an emission pathway held out of training, at roughly one GPU-hour per simulated century instead of the thousands of CPU-hours the full models require?

Gridless Flow — Mesh-Free Neural Solvers for Incompressible Flow Around Unseen Geometries: How accurately do physics-informed networks and DeepONets solve 3D incompressible flow around unseen obstacle shapes versus finite-volume solvers at matched compute, and does conditioning on a signed-distance encoding of the geometry let one trained model generalize across a whole family of shapes without retraining?

Zoom Operator — Zero-Shot Super-Resolution of Neural Operators for Multiscale PDE Solving: When Fourier, wavelet and transformer operators are trained at 64-squared resolution on Darcy flow, Kolmogorov flow and the shallow-water equations, how much does error grow when evaluated at 256 and 1,024 squared, and does a learned high-frequency correction close the gap to solvers run directly at the target resolution?

Generative Precipitation Nowcasting From Radar at Kilometer Scale Over Europe: Does a latent diffusion model trained on eight years of composite radar on 16 A100s produce zero-to-three-hour nowcasts with better continuous ranked probability score, heavy-rain critical success index and spectral sharpness than DGMR, NowcastNet and optical-flow extrapolation, especially for storms forming inside the window?

Island Step — Learned Time-Steppers for Magnetohydrodynamics in Tokamak Plasma Simulation: Can an autoregressive neural operator trained on 5,000 nonlinear simulations of tokamak instabilities predict the growth and saturation of tearing modes over ten milliseconds of plasma time within 5 percent error on magnetic island width, and how far does it extrapolate to higher Lundquist numbers than seen in training?
Closure Net: Can a neural subgrid model trained on 2048-cubed direct simulation keep a large-eddy simulation of channel flow stable over 100 eddy turnover times at four-times-coarser grids?

Eddy Twin — Neural Emulation of a High-Resolution Ocean Model: Can a neural emulator of a twelfth-degree ocean model reproduce mesoscale eddy statistics, Gulf Stream separation and heat transport over a 50-year rollout without drifting from the parent model?
