Multi-Step Retrosynthesis Planning With Learned Reaction Models and Search: Does a template-free transformer single-step model trained on three million reactions, paired with Monte Carlo tree search, solve more of a held-out set of 1,000 drug-like targets within five minutes than Retro-star and AiZynthFinder, and how often do chemists judge the top routes practically executable in a wet lab?

Fold Speed — Distilling Structure Prediction Into Fast Models for Proteome-Scale Screening: Can a distilled student predictor reach within 1 GDT of a teacher folding model on CASP targets while running 20 times faster, enabling conformational ensembles for a full proteome, and does accuracy hold on orphan sequences with shallow homolog coverage and few relatives?

Dock Rank — Learning Scoring Functions for Virtual Screening Against Kinase Targets: Can a geometric deep-learning scorer trained on 2 million protein-ligand complexes and activity labels rank actives above decoys on DUD-E and a prospective kinase library better than Glide and AutoDock Vina, and do its top-ranked hits confirm at a higher rate when 200 are synthesized and assayed?

Atom Bench — Benchmarking Pretrained Molecular Representations for Low-Data Property Prediction: When graph, transformer and 3D-equivariant molecular encoders are pretrained on 100 million unlabeled compounds and fine-tuned on scarce assay data, which pretraining objective transfers best to solubility, lipophilicity and binding-affinity tasks on scaffold-split benchmarks, and how large must the labeled set be before pretraining stops helping?

Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials for Molecular Dynamics at Ab-Initio Accuracy: Can an equivariant message-passing potential trained on ten million density-functional reference structures run stable nanosecond molecular dynamics of proteins and electrolytes within chemical accuracy of the reference, and how do its speed and energy conservation compare with classical force fields and earlier neural potentials across unseen chemistries?
Alloy Search: Can graph-network active learning map a stable five-element alloy region with far fewer simulations?

Binder Yield — De Novo Minibinder Design Tested in the Wet Lab: What fraction of de novo minibinders designed by diffusion and sequence networks against 20 therapeutic protein targets bind under 100 nanomolar when expressed, and which geometric filters best predict which will succeed?

Transient Net — Real-Time Photometric Classification of Astronomical Transients for Survey Alerts: Can a recurrent and transformer classifier trained on simulated and labeled light curves tag supernovae, kilonovae and tidal disruption events from early partial photometry on a nightly alert stream, and how does its early-epoch purity and completeness compare with template-fitting and random-forest baselines under realistic cadence gaps?

Jet Tagger — Graph and Transformer Networks for Boosted Jet Flavor Identification at Colliders: Trained on 100 million simulated jets, does a particle-cloud transformer improve top, W and bottom-quark tagging over graph and deep-set baselines at fixed background acceptance, how stable is tagging accuracy to parton-shower and detector-simulation choices, and how much does efficiency shift on an out-of-sample generator?

Event Weaver — Deep Learning Reconstruction of Neutrino Interactions in Liquid-Argon Detectors: Can a sparse 3D convolutional and graph pipeline reconstruct vertices, track directions and particle types in liquid-argon detector images with better efficiency and resolution than the current reconstruction chain, and how does performance hold on rare multi-track topologies and under shifted detector noise and response?

Self-Supervised Representations of Stellar Spectra for Parameter Estimation: Can a masked-modeling encoder pretrained on 10 million unlabeled stellar spectra be fine-tuned to estimate temperature, surface gravity and metallicity with scatter matching supervised pipelines using a tenth of the labels, and do its learned representations transfer across two surveys with different resolution and wavelength coverage?

Shower Fast — Generative Surrogates for Calorimeter Simulation in Collider Experiments: Can a diffusion and normalizing-flow surrogate reproduce calorimeter shower shapes, energy response and correlations well enough to replace part of the full detector simulation, cutting compute by over 100 times while keeping downstream physics observables within systematic error bars across a wide energy range?

Lens Hunt — Strong Lenses in Billion-Galaxy Surveys: Can a convolutional classifier find strong gravitational lenses with enough purity to cut human inspection a hundredfold without losing rare systems?
Pulse Finder — Candidate Selection for Radio Pulsar Surveys: Can a deep classifier recover faint pulsar and fast-radio-burst candidates at higher completeness than matched-filter pipelines?

Muon Track — Fast Graph-Network Reconstruction in a Cubic-Kilometer Neutrino Telescope: Can a graph network reconstruct muon trajectories and energies in a cubic-kilometer neutrino telescope faster and more accurately than likelihood fits, and does accuracy hold for near-horizontal events and across the detector's noisy outer strings during live operation at the pole?

Wave Catch — Deep Detection of Compact-Binary Mergers in Gravitational-Wave Strain: Can a convolutional and transformer detector flag black-hole and neutron-star mergers in detector strain at lower latency than matched filtering while holding the false-alarm rate fixed on real noise?

Curvature Budget — Amortised Shampoo and SOAP Preconditioners for 1B-Parameter Transformer Pretraining: When Shampoo, SOAP and K-FAC preconditioners are refreshed every k steps instead of every step on 8 H100s, how does wall-clock time to a fixed C4 validation loss change against tuned AdamW and Lion for k from 1 to 100, does the best k shift with batch size, and at what model width does the preconditioner memory overhead stop paying for itself?

Testing Schedule-Free AdamW Against Warmup-Stable-Decay on Long Training Runs: Does schedule-free AdamW match a tuned warmup-stable-decay schedule on 350M and 1.3B language models trained for 50B to 300B tokens, how sensitive is each to peak learning rate across a 16x sweep, and can a single short cooldown appended to a schedule-free run recover the final-loss gap at under 5% extra compute?

Closing the Theory–Practice Gap for Adam on Heavy-Tailed Gradient Noise: Under what assumptions on gradient-noise tails and coordinate-wise smoothness does Adam with constant beta2 provably converge on nonconvex objectives, do these assumptions hold in gradient statistics, and do the predicted step-size thresholds match where divergence occurs in a 200-run sweep?

Natural Adapters — Kronecker-Factored Natural-Gradient Updates for Low-Rank Adapters: Can a K-FAC optimiser applied only to LoRA adapter matrices reach the fine-tuning loss of AdamW in 30% fewer steps on Llama-3-8B, what is the per-step overhead on a single A100, and does the advantage persist when adapter rank grows from 4 to 256?
Warmup Why — Learning-Rate Warmup and Adam: Does warmup help Adam by limiting early updates?
Cyclic or Cosine — Schedules for Small-Batch Vision: On CIFAR-10 with batch size 32, do one-cycle and cosine-with-restarts schedules reach 94% accuracy in fewer epochs than plain cosine decay?

4-Bit Speech Recognition on Mid-Range Android Phones: Can 4-bit weight quantisation with per-group scales plus an 8-bit KV cache bring Whisper-small to a real-time factor below 0.3 on a Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 CPU, how much word error rate on LibriSpeech test-other, Common Voice and FLEURS is lost versus FP16, and does quantisation-aware fine-tuning on 100 hours of speech recover the gap for accented and noisy speakers?

Sparse and Fast — Structured 2:4 Pruning That Actually Speeds Up Mobile Vision: For MobileNetV3, EfficientNet-Lite and ConvNeXt-T, does 2:4 and block-structured pruning yield measured latency gains on Pixel 8 and iPhone 15 neural accelerators matching their theoretical FLOP savings, what ImageNet top-1 drop accompanies 40% and 60% sparsity, and which layers, such as depthwise convolutions and the classifier head, should stay dense to keep the accuracy loss under one point?

Tiny Teacher Chains — Multi-Stage Distillation for Keyword Spotting on Cortex-M Chips: Does distilling from a 30M-parameter audio transformer through an intermediate 2M-parameter student into a 50k-parameter CNN on an ARM Cortex-M4 beat direct distillation on Google Speech Commands v2 accuracy at under 20 ms latency and 256 KB SRAM, and how many teacher-assistant stages are optimal?

Latency-Measured Bit-Width Allocation for On-Device Detection and Segmentation: Can a search that measures real on-device latency rather than proxy BitOPs find per-layer 2/4/8-bit allocations for YOLOv8-n and DeepLabV3-MobileNet that dominate uniform INT8 on the Pareto front of COCO mAP and Jetson Orin Nano latency, and how many on-device measurements does the search need to converge when the target hardware changes from Orin Nano to a Hexagon DSP?

Speculative on the Edge — Draft-Model Decoding for On-Phone Small Language Models: When a 1.5B language model runs at 4-bit on a phone NPU, does a 100M-parameter distilled draft model with speculative decoding raise tokens per second by more than 1.8x on summarisation and chat prompts without changing outputs, and how do draft length and battery draw trade off over 30-minute sessions on Pixel 8 and Galaxy S24 handsets?

Combining SVD Compression with 3-Bit Weights for Vision Transformers: Does factorising ViT-B/16 MLP blocks into low-rank plus sparse components before 3-bit quantisation give a smaller ImageNet accuracy loss than either technique alone at an equal model size of 12 MB, and what latency does each variant achieve on a Raspberry Pi 5 and an Apple A17 chip when the low-rank kernels are fused with the dequantisation step?
Pruning at Initialisation Versus After Training: Do pruning-at-initialisation methods beat magnitude pruning after training on mobile ImageNet models?

Distilled Depth — Monocular Depth for AR Glasses: Can a 3M-parameter student distilled from Depth Anything V2 run at 30 fps on a Snapdragon AR1 chip within 10% of the teacher's NYUv2 error, and does INT8 cost more accuracy than halving width?

Trees Still Win — Gradient Boosting Versus Tabular Transformers on 300 Real Datasets: Across 300 OpenML classification and regression tables with 1k to 1M rows, do tuned XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost still beat TabPFN-v2, FT-Transformer and TabR under equal 4-GPU-hour tuning budgets, and which dataset properties such as row count, skewed columns and categorical cardinality predict when deep models win?

Grid Load Horizons — Day-Ahead Electricity Demand Prediction with Weather Ensembles: Does feeding 50-member ECMWF weather ensembles into a temporal fusion transformer reduce day-ahead MAPE for ERCOT and ENTSO-E regional load beyond a gradient-boosted baseline with point weather inputs, how does the gain change during heatwaves and holidays, and is the improvement worth the added inference cost?

Foundation Forecasters — Zero-Shot Time-Series Models Versus Local Statistical Baselines: Do pretrained time-series models such as Chronos, TimesFM and Moirai beat per-series ETS, ARIMA and LightGBM on the M5 retail, Monash archive and LOTSA hold-out collections at horizons of 7 to 90 steps, how does their accuracy depend on series length, seasonality and intermittency, and does light fine-tuning on 1% of target series close the remaining gaps?

Deep Models for Intermittent Demand in Retail and Aftermarket Inventories: For SKU-level series where over 70% of periods are zero, do DeepAR and N-BEATS with Tweedie or negative-binomial likelihoods beat Croston, TSB and LightGBM on scaled pinball loss across M5 and a 40k-SKU automotive aftermarket dataset, and what inventory cost savings follow at a 95% service level when the predicted quantiles drive a reorder-point simulation over 18 months?

Cross-Table Pretraining for Small Datasets: When a tabular transformer is pretrained on 10k synthetic and 2k real tables, how many labelled rows does a new housing, retail or sensor table need before tuned gradient boosting overtakes it, does the crossover point depend on the mix of numeric and categorical columns, and how far does in-context ensembling over 32 row permutations shift that point?

Renewable Ramps — Short-Horizon Solar and Wind Power Prediction from Sky Images and Turbine Telemetry: Does fusing all-sky camera images with SCADA turbine telemetry and satellite cloud maps in a spatio-temporal transformer cut 15-to-60-minute-ahead ramp-event errors for a 200 MW solar farm and a 50-turbine wind farm compared with persistence and gradient-boosted baselines, and how many months of site history does the model need before it pays off?
Boosting Meets Deep Ensembles — Small Tables: On OpenML tables with under 5,000 rows, does an ensemble of MLPs with strong regularisation match tuned CatBoost on accuracy at equal time?

Hierarchical Reconciliation — Coherent Store and National Sales: For a 30,000-series grocery hierarchy, does MinT reconciliation of LightGBM base predictions beat end-to-end deep hierarchical models on weighted RMSSE at daily and weekly horizons, especially for slow movers?

Beyond 1-WL — Practical Expressivity of Subgraph GNNs on Molecular Benchmarks: Do subgraph GNNs and higher-order k-WL networks that are provably more expressive than message passing actually improve accuracy on ZINC, OGB-molhiv and PCQM4Mv2 once compute is matched, how often do real molecular graphs contain pairs that 1-WL cannot distinguish, and where does the extra memory and runtime cost stop paying off as graphs grow from 30 to 300 nodes?

Link Prediction Reset — Hard Negatives and Realistic Splits for Graph Link Prediction: When ogbl-collab, ogbl-citation2 and ogbl-ppa are re-split by time and scored with hard negatives sampled from 2-hop neighbourhoods, do NCN, BUDDY, NBFNet and SEAL keep their margin over simple heuristics such as Adamic-Adar, resource allocation and common neighbours, and how much of the reported leaderboard progress since 2021 survives the change at matched training budgets?

GNN-Guided Local Search for Large Vehicle Routing: Can a GNN that predicts promising edge swaps guide LKH-3 and OR-Tools local search on CVRP instances with 1k to 10k customers to reach within 1% of best-known solutions in half the wall-clock time, and does a model trained on 100-node instances generalise to the 10k-node logistics instances of the CVRPLib X set?

Sparse Attention for Million-Node Node Classification: Do graph transformers with linear or sampled attention such as NodeFormer, SGFormer and Exphormer beat tuned GraphSAGE and GCNII on ogbn-papers100M and ogbn-products under the same 8-A100 budget, and does positional encoding choice matter more than attention type once random-walk and Laplacian encodings are both tried?

Oversquashing Fixes Compared — Rewiring Versus Virtual Nodes in Long-Range Graph Tasks: On the Long Range Graph Benchmark peptides and PascalVOC-SP tasks, do curvature-based rewiring, expander-graph propagation and a single virtual node give comparable gains over GCN and GINE when hyperparameters are tuned equally, and does effective resistance between distant nodes predict which fix helps most?
GNNs for SAT — Learning Branching Orders: Can a GNN that picks branching variables cut CDCL solve times on industrial SAT Competition instances by a quarter on 8 cores?

Temporal Graphs Without Leakage — Dynamic Link Prediction: On the TGB benchmarks, do TGN, DyGFormer and GraphMixer still beat a recency-based memory heuristic once negative sampling rules out future edges, and which design choices matter at 10M-edge scale on one GPU?

Gaze Typing Faster — Language-Model Decoding for Eye-Tracking Text Entry: For people with motor impairments typing by gaze, does a dwell-free keyboard that decodes approximate gaze paths with an on-device character language model raise entry rates above 20 words per minute versus dwell typing, measured with 24 participants over five sessions, and how do uncorrected error rates and NASA-TLX fatigue scores change between the first and last session?

Layout from Sketch — Generating Editable Mobile UI Layouts from Hand Drawings: Can a diffusion model trained on the RICO and CLAY datasets turn a rough hand-drawn wireframe into an editable view hierarchy with correct component types and spacing constraints, how does its layout-match score compare with retrieval and prompting baselines, and do 16 professional designers save time editing its output versus starting from a blank canvas?

Recommending Visual Encodings in Exploratory Analysis Notebooks: Does a recommender that proposes chart types and encodings from the shape of a pandas dataframe help analysts answer 12 exploratory questions correctly and faster than Tableau Show Me and plain matplotlib in a within-subjects study with 30 data scientists, and does it narrow or widen the range of charts they inspect?

Switch Access Reimagined — Predictive Scanning for Single-Switch Users: For people who operate a computer with one switch, can predicting the next on-screen target from screen context and past actions shorten row-column scanning sequences by half in web browsing and email tasks, and how do selection time, error rate and perceived workload change in a two-week deployment with 12 participants?

Thumb Zones — Adaptive Touch Keyboard Geometry for Large Phones: Does a keyboard that reshapes key sizes and positions from each person's touch distribution over the first 2,000 taps lower error rates for one-handed typing on 6.7-inch phones compared with the stock Gboard layout in a two-week, 40-participant field study, and does the benefit persist when the phone moves to the other hand or the person is walking on a treadmill?
Swipe or Tap — Gesture Typing on Smartwatches: Does gesture typing beat tap typing on 40 mm watch screens?

Sonified Charts — Audio Line Graphs for Blind Users: Do pitch-mapped sonifications let blind participants find trends and peaks in line charts as accurately as sighted readers, and how much training do they need?

Placement Replayed — Reproducing RL Macro Placement Against Analytical Placers: On the TILOS MacroPlacement testcases and ISPD 2015 designs, does RL-based macro placement in the style of AlphaChip match DREAMPlace and simulated annealing on routed wirelength, congestion and timing after full place-and-route in OpenROAD, and how much does pretraining across designs change the outcome at equal GPU-hours?

Predicting Routing Hotspots Before Global Routing: Can a GNN-plus-CNN model trained on 2,000 OpenROAD placements of RISC-V and accelerator designs predict DRC hotspot maps after detailed routing with F1 above 0.7, and does using these predictions to guide cell spreading cut detailed-routing runtime and DRC count on held-out designs at 7 nm and 14 nm from the ASAP7 and GF180 libraries?

Synthesis Recipes — Learning Logic Optimisation Sequences in ABC: Can a transformer trained on 50k synthesis runs over the EPFL and OpenABC-D benchmarks choose ABC command sequences that beat resyn2 and the best of 1,000 random recipes on AND-gate count and logic depth, and does a model trained on arithmetic blocks transfer to random-logic designs with ten times as many nodes?

Timing in a Flash — GNN Static Timing Prediction Before Routing: Does a heterogeneous GNN over the netlist and placed cell graph predict post-route arrival times and slack at every endpoint within 5 ps mean error on 21 open designs from OpenCores and Chipyard, and can it replace incremental static timing analysis inside a timing-driven placer to cut iteration time by 10x without worsening final worst negative slack?

Analog Sizing Copilot — Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimisation with Learned Surrogates for Transistor Sizing: For op-amps, LDOs and comparators in SKY130, does a multi-fidelity Bayesian optimiser with a GNN surrogate shared across topologies reach spec-meeting sizings in fewer SPICE simulations than per-topology BO and evolutionary search, and how many simulations does a new topology need to reach 90% yield?

Diffusion Models for Macro Floorplanning: Can a diffusion model conditioned on a netlist graph generate macro floorplans for designs with 100 to 1,000 macros that, after legalisation and the full OpenROAD flow, match or beat analytical placement on half-perimeter wirelength and worst negative slack, and how does sample count trade off against runtime on 4 A100s compared with a single run of a commercial-style annealer?
Lithography Hotspots — CNN Pattern Matching: Can a CNN flag lithography hotspots in 7 nm layouts faster than rule-based pattern matching?

Clock Trees by Learning — Learned Buffer Insertion: Can a GNN that proposes buffer locations for clock tree synthesis in OpenROAD cut clock skew and power against TritonCTS defaults on 15 open designs without lengthening runtime?

Benchmarking Foundation Models for Single-Cell Batch Integration: Do single-cell foundation models such as scGPT, Geneformer and UCE beat scVI, Seurat CCA and highly-variable-gene PCA at integrating 10 million cells from the CELLxGENE census across 50 studies, measured by batch mixing and cell-type separation scores, and does zero-shot embedding quality improve with pretraining corpus size?

Hard Regions — Long-Read Variant Calling in Segmental Duplications and Tandem Repeats: For HiFi and Oxford Nanopore R10 reads, do DeepVariant, Clair3 and PEPPER reach comparable SNV and indel F1 in segmental duplications and tandem repeats against the GIAB HG002 v4.2 and T2T-based benchmark sets, and how much does coverage below 20x hurt each caller in these regions, and does phasing with whatshap recover the lost calls?

Perturbation Prediction — Predicting Single-Cell Responses to Unseen Gene Knockouts: On Perturb-seq screens of more than 2,000 knockouts in K562 and RPE1 cells, do deep models such as GEARS, CPA and scGPT beat a linear model on mean expression and a nearest-neighbour baseline at predicting expression changes for held-out single and double knockouts, and how does performance depend on the number of genes perturbed together and on cell-line transfer?

Spatial Deconvolution — Mapping Cell Types in Visium Spots with Single-Cell References: How accurately do cell2location, RCTD and Tangram recover cell-type proportions in 55-micron Visium spots when checked against matched Xenium single-cell data from the same tissue sections, and does accuracy hold for rare cell types below 2% abundance and across brain, tumour and lymph-node tissues?

Learned Calling for Low-Coverage Exome Sequencing: Can a convolutional caller trained on 1,000 high-depth exomes recover rare SNVs and indels from the same samples downsampled to 10x and 15x with F1 within 2 points of the full-depth calls, and how does adding haplotype imputation from the 1000 Genomes reference panel change accuracy for allele frequencies below 0.1% across European, African and East Asian ancestry samples?

Graph-Based Read Mapping Versus Linear References: Does mapping short reads to the HPRC pangenome graph with vg giraffe instead of GRCh38 with BWA-MEM reduce false-positive SNV and structural-variant calls across 100 diverse genomes, at what extra CPU-hour cost per sample, and which genomic regions account for most of the gain, especially in the MHC and other highly polymorphic loci?
Doublet Finder Showdown: Which of scDblFinder, DoubletFinder and Scrublet best removes doublets in 10x Chromium data?

RNA Velocity Revisited — Recovering Known Lineages: Across 20 single-cell datasets with CellTag and LARRY lineage barcodes, do scVelo, veloVI and UniTVelo infer differentiation direction more often than diffusion pseudotime, and how does depth change that?
